description: NSW Speed Cameras is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Transport for NSW. This dataset includes location points of Fixed Speed Cameras which are used at high-risk locations or in areas with a history of severe crashes and Red Light Speed Cameras which are installed to reduce crashes at high-risk intersections with traffic lights. Mobile Speed Camera locations (street and suburb) are also provided. Coverage is New South Wales, 2011 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-07-31. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
